The lab openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-work2 (work2) is shared with other DOC-030 walkthrough agents. This run created only records named "DOC-030 entities ..." (run tag 0925-1129), plus records from earlier development runs of the same script with other tags. API calls prepared fixtures or read back results the browser had already shown; every documented action ran through the browser controls.

Author limitation, checked on the lab: The V-C31 duplicate-input check has no refusal to show for Entities: a repeated legal name creates a second Entity by design. The guide says so. For Counterparties the picker withholds a second creation of an exact existing name.
Author limitation, checked on the lab: Counterparty rename, merge, archive and restore have no staff page in this build; the guide states this rather than inventing a control.

3 page loads showed the app's "Something went wrong." screen with net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED while other labs changed the host's Docker networks; the script reloaded once and the step then passed. This is an environment effect, not an app finding.

Step 5 (Fields required for creation) needs an Entity type whose Form marks a Field required. No seeded type has one, so the walkthrough added its own type "DOC-030 entities V-C31 <tag> required type" (Local counsel required), reassigned its Entities to Corporation afterwards and archived it. No seeded type or organization setting was changed.
The Business User check used Diego Salas (Business User, fresh magic link from the lab Mailpit) instead of Jonas Weber, whose sign-in link budget is shared with other walkthrough agents on this lab.

Not exercised: the recovery notes about a Contract type Form Branch hiding Our entity or Counterparties, and about an unavailable Entity type. Both need a change to a shared type on the lab that other walkthroughs depend on.
